images.title: Two views of one cube
images.purpose: Show the two views of the concept's cube: sun on top with the heart on the left and the leaf on the right, then sun on top with the leaf on the left and the moon on the right, so that the heart and the moon can be seen to touch the same two faces.
images.composition: Two isometric cubes side by side, each with its three visible faces carrying a picture, with the reasoning written in two lines under them.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two cubes drawn in the same isometric style, each showing exactly three faces: a top rhombus, a left parallelogram and a right parallelogram, all white with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px). Each cube edge is 190 px long. VIEW 1 (left): the vertex where the three faces meet is at (400, 360). Top face corners: (400, 360), (235, 265), (400, 170), (565, 265). Left face corners: (400, 360), (235, 265), (235, 455), (400, 550). Right face corners: (400, 360), (565, 265), (565, 455), (400, 550). On the top face, centred at (400, 265): a sun, an amber #E69F00 disc 56 px across with 8 short rays. On the left face, centred at (318, 408): a reddish purple #CC79A7 heart 70 px wide. On the right face, centred at (482, 408): a green #009E73 leaf 76 px long. VIEW 2 (right): the vertex where the three faces meet is at (1056, 360). Top face corners: (1056, 360), (891, 265), (1056, 170), (1221, 265). Left face corners: (1056, 360), (891, 265), (891, 455), (1056, 550). Right face corners: (1056, 360), (1221, 265), (1221, 455), (1056, 550). On the top face, centred at (1056, 265): the same amber sun. On the left face, centred at (974, 408): the same green leaf. On the right face, centred at (1138, 408): a teal #0072B2 crescent moon 70 px high. Every picture is drawn flat on its face and skewed to follow the face, with no other marks on the faces. TEXT: View 1 in bold dark #1F2937 sans-serif (44 px) centred at (400, 105); View 2 in the same style centred at (1056, 105). Centred at (728, 640): the line The heart and the moon both touch the sun and the leaf (40 px, dark). Centred at (728, 720): the line So the heart is opposite the moon in bold (56 px, dark). In all: 2 cubes, 6 visible faces, 6 pictures (the sun twice, the leaf twice, the heart once, the moon once). Nothing else in the frame.

So the heart is opposite the moon

images.takeaway: The heart and the moon both touch the sun and the leaf, so they are opposite faces of the cube.
images.description: Two views of a cube: View 1 shows the sun on top, the heart on the left and the leaf on the right; View 2 shows the sun on top, the leaf on the left and the moon on the right.
images.context: Concept image for Faces of a Cube and Its Net. It shows the concept's own cube with a sun, a moon, a heart and a leaf and not a figure from your maths book.
images.teaching_notes: Ask which faces touch the heart in View 1 and which touch the moon in View 2. The slip to watch is thinking that two faces seen in different views can still be next to each other when they touch the same two faces.

image_decisions.why: The two cube views with their pictures are the mathematics: the child reads which faces touch the heart and the moon directly from the pictures.
